For clinics and service businesses

AI Receptionist

Customers message at night, during rush hour, or while your staff are busy. If nobody replies, they book somewhere else. Havlen answers on WhatsApp and on your website, books against your real calendar, and hands the chat to a person when it should.

  • Replies in the customer's language. English or Roman Urdu, decided message by message.
  • Never double-books. It checks the live calendar before offering a slot, and again before booking it.
  • Knows when to stop. Words like "dard" or "urgent", or a request for a person, alert your staff at once.
  • Staff app for Android. Today's schedule, new bookings and urgent alerts, with take-over in one tap.

For print and photocopy shops

Print Shop Suite

Print shops copy ID cards and make passport photos all day, lining them up by hand and wasting paper on misprints. These three tools do it at exact physical size, offline, on the computer the shop already has.

  • CNIC Duplex. Up to eight ID cards per sheet, front and back lined up exactly. Calibrate once per printer.
  • QuickPrint. Passport, visa and CNIC photos on 4×6 or A4 at true size, saved as a 300 DPI PDF.
  • Print Bridge. Customers print from their phone to the shop's USB printer over Wi-Fi.

No internet needed. Customer photos and ID cards stay on the shop's own network.

Product questions

What clinics and shops ask us

What does the AI Receptionist cost?

It depends on how many messages you get and how much you want it to handle, so we quote after a short first call instead of putting a made-up number here. The demo on your own business is free.

Will my customers know it isn't a person?

If someone asks, it tells them, and offers to fetch a member of staff. It is direct and polite and does not pretend to be human.

What happens when it doesn't know an answer?

It says so and hands the conversation to your staff with the whole chat attached. It will not invent a price, a time slot or a policy.

Where is my data kept?

The system and its database run on a computer you control: a laptop in your office or a small server. Messages still pass through WhatsApp and the AI model that writes the replies, and we tell you exactly which services are involved before you sign up.

Do the print tools need the internet?

No. They run on the shop's own computer and network, and photos and ID cards stay there.
